clauseNo.reason: CUAD has no clause numbers. qa ids are annotation ids (contract title + category), not clause numbers; using them would fake uniqueness.

topic.reason: The 41 expert categories are clause subjects; mapped 1:1 to 条款主题 for the 36 clause-like categories.

text.reason: Each answer span is a verbatim excerpt from the contract. It is whitespace-collapsed, not rewritten.

stance.reason: CUAD annotates clause presence/type, never a negotiation stance or acceptance attitude; CS-002 is excluded.

riskLevel.reason: CUAD has no risk rating (high/medium/low). A category such as Uncapped Liability is a clause type, not a risk level; CS-003 is excluded.

riskNote.reason: No CUAD equivalent; no rule consumes it.

fallback.reason: CUAD has no negotiation fallback/bottom line; CS-004 is excluded.

mustHave.reason: CUAD does not mark any clause as must-have/必保; CS-004 is excluded.

owner.reason: CUAD has no negotiation owner; CS-004 is excluded.

note.reason: No CUAD equivalent; no rule consumes it.

contractNo.reason: CUAD has no contract number field.

contractName.cuad: Document Name answer, else contract title
contractName.reason: Mapped to the header; CS-006 still needs party, so only this half is available.

party.reason: CUAD Parties is all signatories, not 本方; CS-006 is excluded.

counterparty.reason: CUAD does not label which signatory is the counterparty; no rule consumes it.

checkedAt.reason: A run timestamp is not a dataset fact; no rule consumes it.

limitations: CUAD is a corpus of English commercial contracts (US); this is not a Chinese contract, Chinese law, or Chinese enterprise-ledger sample.

Only CS-001 and CS-007 are CUAD-groundable. CS-002..CS-006 are excluded; no stance, risk rating, fallback, must-have flag, owner, clause number, own-side party, counterparty or version is synthesized.
The rule pack contains no stance-vs-fallback or risk-level-vs-clause consistency rule. The corresponding probes return zero findings by design/scope, not because a declared check missed them.
P/R measures detection of one-defect clones of real CUAD-derived rows, not prevalence, legal accuracy, or performance on unseen negotiations.

The adapter keeps one expert answer span per contract/category, only for 36 clause-like categories, at most five contracts per category, and filters spans shorter than 40 characters or already containing a CS-007 placeholder term.
The full-pack run on the CUAD ledger reports CS-006 missing party. That is a true statement about the adapted ledger (party is not provided), not a false positive of a scored rule.
cases.json and .data/ are gitignored; no contract text is committed. CUAD is CC BY 4.0 and attribution is in README.md.
The tool's only argument collapses unselected rules into one skipped entry; evaluation filters issues by ruleId. This is a reporting detail, not a scoring shortcut.

Known gap (boundary probe): CS-001 does not report a row that omits the 条款原文 key entirely while another row carries the column; the engine only holds rows that carry the column to the presence check. A row with an explicit blank string is reported correctly and is the scored positive.
